<MethodEndpoint

  context={"endpoint"}

Retrieves Mobile reward totals grouped by `service_provider_id` for a given time range. Only rewards with a populated `service_provider_id` (i.e. `service_provider_reward` and `promotion_reward` reward types) are included. Requires the OracleData feature with aggregate endpoints enabled.
